translations.web: Do they provoke me to anger?” says Yahweh. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”
translations.bsb: But am I the One they are provoking? declares the LORD. Is it not themselves they spite, to their own shame?
translations.kjv: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
translations.asv: Do they provoke me to anger? saith Jehovah; do they not provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?
